title: Filler: Flowers for the Yamanaka Shop
later: I'd ask you a favour, but you look busy. Come find me when you're free!

offer.speaker: ino
offer.text: Hey, new kid! My family's flower shop is short on stock and Dad's out. Help me out?

offer.speaker: ino
offer.text: Pick me some poppies and dandelions from around the village and bring them to the shop. It's on the main street, east of here.

steps.text: Bring the flowers to the Yamanaka flower shop

dialogue.speaker: ino
dialogue.text: Perfect! Poppies mean remembrance, dandelions mean happiness. Every flower says something, you know.

dialogue.speaker: ino
dialogue.text: Don't tell Sakura I needed help. Here, for your trouble.
